description: AI-in-the-loop visually verified ground-truth placements for ~/Downloads/PG_SITE 1A.pdf (22-page Fontana precise-grading set). Every seam adjudicated by rendering red/blue overlays and confirming matchline-border coincidence plus content continuity across the seam (Claude session 2026-07-20). Use as the regression target for the auto-stitch solver.
originConventionNote: EVERY value in `positions` is the origin of the WHOLE PAGE, including the strip keys: a strip's entry says where its page's top-left corner would sit if that strip is placed where the fixture says. The solver reports each pose's FRAME origin instead (`posFt` anchors `frame`, not the page), so the runner must subtract frame[0],frame[1] (page pt x scale/rootFtPerIn) before comparing. Comparing the two directly read PG_SITE's lower strip as 170.7 ft out when it is 16.6 ft out — the 646 pt frame inset, 179 ft at this scale. Do not remove this note: the whole point of these three fields is that the convention is never inferred again.
pageIndexKey: a plain numeric key is a whole page (0-based pageIndex). A key of the form `<pageIndex>s<n>` is one strip frame of a split page, numbered from 1 in ascending frame order (top strip first, then left): `1s1` is pageIndex 1's [0,0,2592,646.11] frame and `1s2` its [0,646.11,2592,1728] frame.

solverDeltasAtVerification.note: corrections applied to the solver output of commit 6dd8024 to reach ground truth, in canvas pt (divide by 3.6 for ft)

verificationCriteria: thick dashed matchline borders of adjacent sheets coincide (dashes interleave on one line, SEE SHEET labels flank it)
streets/curbs/courtyard fences crossing a matchline continue at the same station
stepped matchline corners (p7-p10 seam) mate corner-to-corner
strip sibling seam: 1s2 west border coincides with 1s1 east border; overlap column content duplicates in register
knownSolverFailuresThisFixtureCatches: p7/p10 east-column ~40-50 ft x-misplacement (deep west-border insets defeat nearest-to-label stroke pick)
p8 ~22 ft y-drift (un-anchored pair redistribution under W_STROKE reweighting)
strip along-axis: 1s1 +20 ft, 1s2 dx from sibling seam (no crossing signal on p9-side border)
